preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
Length of the array N is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines must be equal to the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(output_line) == N for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line must contain N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in output_line) for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output line must be between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(max(output_line) == min(output_line) for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: The maximum element in each output line must be equal to the minimum element.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(output_line.count(x) % 2 == 0 for x in output_line) for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: There must not exist a subarray with all elements occurring in even frequency.
